title: Publicis agrees to acquire LiveRamp, which allows companies to share and build new data sets and models that can power agentic frameworks, for $2.2B in cash (Alison Weissbrot/Adweek)
summary: Alison Weissbrot / Adweek: Publicis agrees to acquire LiveRamp, which allows companies to share and build new data sets and models that can power agentic frameworks, for $2.2B in cash — Publicis Groupe has agreed to acquire LiveRamp for $2.2 billion in a deal funded by a mix of cash and debt, the French holding company said Sunday.
